usage:
import os

from openai import Client

client = Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

result = client.containers.create(name="string", file_ids=["string"], expires_after={"anchor": "last_active_at", "minutes": 1}, skills=[{"type": "skill_reference", "skill_id": "string", "version": "string"}], memory_limit="1g", network_policy={"type": "disabled"})
print(result)

typeReference.signature: client.containers.create(name, file_ids=..., expires_after=..., skills=..., memory_limit=..., network_policy=...) -> ContainerResource

fields.description: Name of the container to create.

fields.name: file_ids
fields.description: IDs of files to copy to the container.

fields.name: expires_after
fields.description: Container expiration time in seconds relative to the 'anchor' time.

fields.name: skills
fields.description: An optional list of skills referenced by id or inline data.

fields.name: memory_limit
fields.description: Optional memory limit for the container. Defaults to "1g".

fields.name: network_policy
fields.description: Network access policy for the container.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the container was created.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status of the container (e.g., active, deleted).

fields.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the container was last active.
